maya.docs: Dropped a draft PR that introduces an 'HSM failover & migration notes' appendix for Private/VPC installs. Focus: minimal config diffs, HSM failover checklist, and tiny SDK conn-check snippets for semi-airgapped installs. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4955
oscar.eng: Love the appendix. Can we show a small config diff for switching from managed KMS to pkcs11 and a short note about exporting key-wrap metadata to a staging HSM first? Keep everything placeholder-only.
sophia.sec: Security: please add an explicit line: never check in key material or literal credentials. Also note least-privilege operator accounts and auditing the HSM ACLs before migration.
liam.sre: From SRE: include a short failover checklist (verify PKCS11 path, HSM network reachability, operator role mapping, test restore on staging, then failover). Also add MTU and NAT hairpin tips for baremetal. Example troubleshooting command: `dmesg | grep -i mtu`
maya.docs: Adding both. Draft config diff (placeholder-only):
```diff
- kms:
-   type: managed
-   endpoint: https://kms-managed.example
+ kms:
+   type: pkcs11
+   pkcs11_module: /opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so
+   slot: 1
+   label: redwood-kms
```
oscar.eng: Wording change: use "configure pkcs11 plugin path via the KMS connector" rather than "open pkcs11". Also include a tiny Node and Go conn-check snippet that point to a private host (no prod hostnames).
maya.docs: Node snippet:```js
// Node conn-check example
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new RedwoodClient({ baseURL: 'https://private.local' });
await client.connCheck({ host: '10.0.0.5', port: 443 });
```
Go snippet:```go
// Go conn-check example
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{BaseURL: "https://private.local"})
status, _ := client.ConnCheck("10.0.0.5", 443)
fmt.Println(status)
```
sophia.sec: LGTM. Add a short key-rotation caveat: do NOT perform global key-wrap rotation during peak windows; snapshot HSM policies before rotating.
liam.sre: Also recommend adding a minimal egress CIDR example for semi-airgapped conn-checks: e.g., 203.0.113.0/24:443 and 198.51.100.0/24:443. And mention DNS fallback to internal resolver or 1.1.1.1 if allowed.
